title: Ordinary representative evaluation with K-injective coefficient
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open, and choose a derived category of modules on the over-site of U in morphism universe w [def-pc-derived-category]. Write E for the exact derived over-equivalence into the standard derived category of U.toScheme [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. Let K,N be arbitrary objects of that standard category. Let P,F be actual complexes on the over-site, with F K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex], Hom(P,-) preserve every quasi-isomorphism [def-pur-hom-complex], and the actual dual Hom(P,O_U[0]) be K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Suppose eK:E(QP)≅K and eN:E(QF)≅N. Let f:Tot(F tensor Hom(P,O_U[0]))→Hom(P,F) satisfy [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data]. Put H=RHom on U.toScheme [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], D=H(K,1), and g the canonical adjunct of associator; identity_N tensor evaluation_D,K; right unitor, using [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection] and [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. There exist isomorphisms a:N tensor D≅E(Q Tot(F tensor Hom(P,O_U[0]))) and b:H(K,N)≅E(Q Hom(P,F)) with g;b.hom=a.hom;E(Qf). No object of D(O_X) and no restriction of a global evaluation arrow appear.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary transport lemma to the concrete degreewise image T of the over-equivalence. Obtain the tensor chain isomorphism t, the Hom chain isomorphism b, the transported Hom exactness, dual K-flatness and coefficient K-injectivity, and the transported evaluation formula.

The exact derived functor factorization v:Q;E isomorphic to T;Q identifies Q(TP) with K and Q(TF) with N by v.inverse followed by eK and eN. Apply the single-site K-injective evaluation model theorem to t.inverse;T(f);b. It gives a',b' and their evaluation square.

Compose a' with Q(t).inverse and v_tensor.inverse, and b' with Q(b).inverse and v_Hom.inverse. Substitute the single-site square; functoriality cancels Q(b);Q(b.inverse). Naturality of v.inverse on f gives Q(T(f));v_Hom.inverse=v_tensor.inverse;E(Q(f)). Postcomposing this equality with a';Q(t.inverse) is exactly the required square.

theorem exists_exactSource_kInjective_evaluation_open_models (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K N : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme)
    (P F : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ)
    (_hhom : ∀ (M M' : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ) (t : M ⟶ M'),
      QuasiIso t → QuasiIso (((homComplexFunctor (R := X.sheaf.over U)).obj (op P)).map t))
    (_hdual : (localEvaluationDual X U P).IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (_eK : (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ K)
    (_eN : (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F) ≅ N)
    (f : localEvaluationTensor X U P F ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U) P F)
    (_hf : IsLocalOrdinaryEvaluation X U P F f) [F.IsKInjective] :
    let E := (Equivalence.functor
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := derivedInternalHom
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) U.toScheme.sheaf
    let D := H.obj (op K, 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme))
    let g := ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv U.toScheme) (N ⊗ D) K N).symm
      ((α_ N D K).hom ≫ N ◁
        ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv U.toScheme) D K
          (𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme)) (𝟙 D)) ≫ (ρ_ N).hom)
    ∃ a : N ⊗ D ≅ E.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (localEvaluationTensor X U P F)),
      ∃ b : H.obj (op K, N) ≅
          E.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (homComplex (R := X.sheaf.over U) P F)),
        g ≫ b.hom = a.hom ≫ E.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map f)
